assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a single unretouched full-body CAMERA PHOTOGRAPH of one fictional adult woman about 30 years old, not a celebrity or an identifiable real person. The image must read as an ordinary real photographic portrait, not an illustration or a fashion drawing. A believable adult face with natural facial asymmetry, brown eyes, chin-length chestnut-brown bob, individual stray hairs, realistic skin pores, subtle under-eye texture, small natural tonal variations, normal hands and fingernails, ordinary healthy adult proportions. Quiet neutral expression, looking toward camera. Wearing an actual deep teal cotton chore jacket worn open, two square front pockets, ivory cotton crewneck T-shirt, muted terracotta straight-leg full-length trousers, plain white low-top sneakers. Real fabric weave, creases, seams and gravity. Neutral front-facing standing posture, arms resting naturally at her sides, feet comfortably apart. Entire head, hands and both shoes visible with generous framing margins, portrait approximately 3:4. Photograph in a real simple daylight studio with a light warm-gray plaster wall and matte floor, broad soft window light from one side and natural reflected fill, believable contact shadows. Natural 50 mm lens perspective, approximately f/5.6, restrained RAW-like colour and contrast, fine realistic photographic grain. Preserve skin texture rather than airbrushing it. No glamour retouching, no doll face, no enlarged eyes, no smooth plastic skin, no drawn outlines, no brushwork, no CGI or 3D-render look, no studio cutout halo. One person only, no panels, no inset, no writing, no watermark. This photograph will be the canonical appearance and clothing reference for three later pose variants.

Use case: identity-preserve, photorealistic-natural. Produce ONE natural camera photograph. IMAGE 1 is the sole identity, clothing and photographic-style reference: preserve this same fictional adult woman, her exact apparent age, facial structure, eye colour, short brown bob and natural skin texture; retain the actual teal cotton jacket, ivory T-shirt, terracotta full-length trousers and white sneakers. Preserve real fabric texture and garment construction. IMAGE 2 supplies only the body pose and front-facing viewpoint. Repose the fully clothed woman from Image 1 to closely follow Image 2. Retain natural photographic light, realistic skin and hair, real hands and fingernails, subtle camera grain and the same gray plaster-wall daylight studio with the same window-light direction. Full figure, all hands and both shoes visible, portrait approximately 3:4 with enough margin; adjust framing only to accommodate the pose. Do not mirror the reference. Keep ordinary realistic proportions and believable weight support. No beautification filter, no skin smoothing, no drawing, no painted shading, no cartoon, no 3D-render gloss, no cutout halo. One woman only, no reference sheet, no duplicate figure, no inset, no text or watermark, and do not include the mannequin drawing. Pose target: the hand on the LEFT side of the image rests on the hip with the elbow bent outward; the opposite arm hangs naturally down on the RIGHT. Follow the reference's shoulder tilt, lateral hip shift, asymmetric legs and foot directions. Only the pose and its necessary natural fabric folds change.

cases.label: 扶腰站立
cases.follows: 扶腰手臂、另一手下垂与非对称站姿可辨。
cases.differences: 腰胯偏移、腿间距与脚尖朝向并非逐点一致；手指和衣服折痕仍重绘。

cases.label: 双臂上伸
cases.follows: 双臂分开上举、近直肘和并拢站姿可辨，双手完整入画。
cases.differences: 袖口位置、衣摆与口袋轮廓随生成变化，构图缩放也与基准不同。

cases.label: 坐姿托腮
cases.follows: 单膝抬起、手扶脸颊、另一掌撑地和前伸腿的关系可辨。
cases.differences: 肘膝接触和腿部透视未做几何验收；裤腿、鞋形及面部细节仍有变化。

assessment: Qualitative visual review only, one output per configuration. No text-only control, fixed-seed test or numerical identity/pose measurement.
notes: 摄影质感与还原具体真人是两个目标；本轮没有真人照片作为身份真值。
同一版本的三个结果各自使用同一张基准人物图和一张原库姿势图，没有串行修改前一张结果。
原库姿势输入来自已下载的真实原图；未把原图复制到公开 app 目录。
本地展示已保存结果，网页尚无实时生成接口。
